name: JUKE JOINT
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Endless blues trio in a back room. Piano, upright bass, brushes, a harp sitting in.
description: JUKE JOINT turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a blues trio playing an endless set in a back room. Piano, upright bass and brushes play slow 12/8 blues, shuffles, minor blues and eight-bar ballads, every tune new: a count-off or intro, the head, piano choruses, sometimes a stop-time chorus, the head out and an ending. A harmonica player sits in on some tunes, answering the piano and taking a chorus. The room murmurs and claps between tunes. On screen, the band on a low stage under one bare bulb, the form below. Thirteen nights.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
